The bit nobody says out loud

You've already had these thoughts.

Straight answers, including the ones that cost us the sale.

Do we even need this hire yet?

Sometimes you don't. We've told clients to wait a quarter and sort out who owns the data first. We'd rather say that than sell you a hire you're not ready for, because we'd like to be the call you make when you are.

Should we just promote someone internally?

Often, yes. Someone who knows your business and has your team's trust starts with an advantage nobody external can buy. We'll assess them against exactly the same standard and tell you honestly if they're ready.

What if they leave after a year?

The real risk, and it's rarely about money. AI leaders leave when the job was oversold or they were given no authority. Both get decided before the offer goes out — which is exactly when we're involved.

Are we about to badly overpay?

You might be. These numbers have moved fast and plenty of people are quoting the top of the market. We'll tell you what's actually being accepted right now, including when the figure you've been given is far too high.
